**Incident:** I also didn't open the SEV3. It was meant to record the deploy, which hasn't happened, and opening it would page the on-call engineer.

3. **Open an incident now for the current problem.** This would be about the v2.3.1 errors, separate from the hotfix. An 18% error rate on checkout may call for a higher severity than SEV3.
